title: WPMS/226/2015 of Rajesh Gupta AND ANOTHER Vs Rent Control and Eviction Officer Dehradun AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
MCC No.451 of 2018
CLMA No.3737 of 2018
In:
Writ Petition No. 226 (M/S) of 2015
Rajesh Gupta & Another .....Petitioners
Vs.

Rent Control & Eviction Officer, Dehrudun & others
 ......Respondents
Mr. Shiv Pandey, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for the respondents.
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
 This writ petition has been preferred by the
petitioners/landlord for the following relief amongst
others:
 "(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of certiorari quashing the order dated
28th July 2014 passed in Suit No. 16/95
passed by the Respondent no.1 learned Rent
Control and Eviction Officer, Dehradun.
(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing the
respondents to hand over the peaceful
possession of the premises in question to the
petitioners.
(iii) Issue any suitable writ, order or
direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem
fit and proper in the circumstances of the
case."
 (iv) Award the cost of writ petition to the
petitioner.

2
2. On the said motion, the Coordinate Bench of
this Court vide its order dated 22.01.2015, petitioners
were directed to take steps for service upon private
respondent nos.2 to 4, calling upon them to file their
counter affidavit within three weeks. In compliance of
the said order, steps were taken on 01.04.2015, these
notices were issued as reported by the Registry on
01.04.2015, it was reported that undelivered envelops
have returned to the office with the remark of postal
authority, "unclaimed returned to sender" in relation
to respondent nos.2 and 4. On the same date, there is
another report which has been submitted by the
Registry in relation to respondent no.3, that neither
undelivered envelop nor Acknowledgement Due has
returned to the office. Consequently, the Coordinate
Bench of this Court on 03.04.2015 had passed the
detailed order and directed the petitioners to serve
respondent nos.2 to 4 by Dasti as well as through
publication in local daily of wide circulation Dainik
Jagran and Amar Ujala.
3. From the order-sheet, it further reveals that in
compliance of order dated 03.04.205, on 08.04.2015,
steps for serving Dasti have been taken by the
petitioners and on 16.04.2015, steps for serving the
respondents by publication were also taken. As per
the endorsement made in the order-sheet on
06.08.2015, an affidavit of service has been filed by the

3
petitioners, fortifying the fact that in compliance of the
order dated 03.04.2015; steps for serving respondent
nos.2 to 4 have already taken by both ways.
4. On scrutiny of the affidavit of service, which is
on record, it shows that the publication in two
newspapers was made in compliance of the order
dated 03.04.2015, as well as, the folio of Dasti service
was also appended with the affidavit of service
mentioning thereby steps have been taken in
compliance of the order dated 03.04.2015 for serving
the respondent nos.2 to 4 by Dasti also, which was
refused to be accepted by them and an averment to
that effect has been made in para 4 of the said affidavit
of service, which reads as under:
"4. That the Dasti Summon dated 08.04.2015
were given to the petitioners to serve upon the
respondent nos.2, 3 & 4, which the petitioners
went to the respondent nos.2, 3 & 4 but they
refused to take the same and as there are
political persons they even refused to make any
endorsement of not receiving "Dasti". A copy of
the Dasti Summons dated 08.04.2015 issued to
the respondent nos.2, 3 & 4 are being filed here
with and marked as Annexure-A3 ."
5. The applicants/respondents to the recall
application submit that as a matter of fact no steps was
taken by the petitioner for effecting service by Dasti, in
compliance of order dated 03.04.2015. Applicants
further submit that no affidavit of service by Dasti has
been filed by the petitioner. In the recall application,

4
the applicants/respondents submitted that they
inspected records of the writ petition prior to filing of the
present recall application. Hence it could be presumed
that they must have gone through affidavit of service
dated 06.08.2015, which includes with it the folio of
Dasti steps taken by the petitioner and the arguments
contained in para 4, the applicants
do not deny or plead contrary to the pleadings in their
recall application. Thus the pleading in present recall
is contrary to the facts on record.
6. Thereafter, the matter was listed on number
of occasions but could not be taken up for one reason
or another. Ultimately, this Court vide its order dated
04.12.2015, after holding service to be sufficient
directed the writ petition to proceed ex parte against
the respondents, because the respondents would be
deemed to have been served through substituted
service made through publication in compliance of the
order dated 03.04.2015. Ultimately, the writ petition
was heard finally and the same has been allowed by
the judgment dated 20.12.2017 sought to be recalled.
7. Today, the recall application along with delay
condonation application which has been preferred by
the respondent nos.2 to 4, it has come up for
consideration before this Court, the
respondents/applicants to show their bonafide regards
their absence had submitted that they could not put in

5
appearance for filing the recall application earlier
because since one of the respondent i.e. respondent
no.2 being a sitting MLA was busy in Assembly
Sessions 20.03.2018 to 26.03.2018. It is to be
remarked that respondents are real brothers who
contested the cause together before the court below.
The other respondent nos.3 and 4 are major who are
conscious of their rights, there is no reason whatsoever
assigned in recall as to what precluded other
respondent nos.3 and 4 from appearing before the
Court and taking necessary steps. Apart from it, the
reason that respondent no.2 was busy in Assembly
Session, cannot be accepted, at the cost of avoidance
of proceedings before constitutional courts. As a
matter of fact, there is no explanation given by the
respondents for not appearing and filing the recall
application after passing of the judgment dated
20.12.2017 till 27.03.2018, particularly when
respondent no.2 was only busy in Assembly Session
and that too for a very short period.
8. Another reason which has been assigned by
the respondents is that prior to 25th of March, 2018,
they had no knowledge of judgment, for the first time,
they could gather the knowledge of the judgment dated
20.12.2017 only on 25.03.2018, hence, they have filed
the recall application with the delay of 67 days. Even
as per pleading knowledge is attributed from telephonic

6
call of one Mr. Rajendra Agarwal. Apart from the fact
that there is no such affidavit of Mr. Rajendra Agarwal
to support the pleadings. Besides the information
which is said to have been given by him and as
pleaded was regarding sale of property and not about
the judgment sought to be recalled.
9. The reason which has been assigned by the
applicants that there was no knowledge of pendency of
the writ petition earlier for the reason that some
manipulation or illegal acts which they contended to
have been conducted by the petitioners, because they
contend that the notices which were sent by the
petitioners were endevoured by petitioners themselves
that they have not been served, hence could not be
received by the respondents. They could not gather
the knowledge of the publication, which has been
made in compliance of the order dated 03.04.2015, but
the fact remains that the affidavit of service which has
been filed by the petitioners on 06.08.2015, they have
annexed the copy of the folio with averment that there
was a refusal to the Dasti notices by the respondents.
The entire recall application is based upon the fact in
compliance of the order dated 03.04.2015, directing the
petitioners to take steps for serving the respondents
Dasti no affidavit of service has been filed. However,
the recall application remains silent pertaining to the

7
averments made in affidavit of service and the folio
annexed with the application of the affidavit of service.
10. Another argument of learned counsel for the
applicants/respondents as raised in support of pleading
in para 8, to the effect that one of the sons of Late
Harish Chandra Gupta, managed to get deponent
served, it cannot be accepted for the reason if there
was any truth in the averments in that even, the notices
as sent by the Court on 22.01.2015 or on 03.04.2015
would have shown the endorsement of service. Rather
it due to non service of notice, Court directed to serve
by publication. From the above facts and manner in
which the respondents have attempted to justify their
stand of absence, seems to be malicious just to harass
the landlord and enjoy the possession of tenement,
despite of cancellation of allotment, which remain
unchallenged by them.
11. In that view of the matter, I do not find any
reason to recall the order/judgment dated 20.12.2017,
hence the delay condonation application is rejected as
reason given therein are after thought and
manipulated, consequently, the recall application is too
rejected.
[
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 02.04.2018
Ravi
